text:
Sam (partnerships): Quick flag: partners reported unexpected charges during last night's marketplace flip. looks like entitlement records were created but the activation worker lagged ~10-20m for some accounts. :disappointed:

Dana (partner-success): Which partners/customers impacted? any enterprise pilots?

Sam (partnerships): Two HW partners: NovaCluster and OrbitSI. Partner success has two customer tickets, one pilot.

Ivy (billing): If usage events landed as invoiceable before activation we should hold billing. Can integrations tag those rows?

Kai (integrations): On it. I'll query events where usage_ts < activation_ts within the cutover window and set billing_hold=true and entitlement_verified=false. sample SQL I ran: ```sql
SELECT id, account_id, usage_ts, activation_ts, partner FROM marketplace_usage WHERE usage_ts < activation_ts AND activation_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-23T01:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-23T02:30:00Z';
```

Rohit (sre): Root cause: activation-worker autoscale metric name changed in deploy. I've reverted the metric and scaled workers; backlog draining. Kicked off replay of activations.

Ivy (billing): Good. Once Kai tags events we'll exclude them from invoice runs and run reconciliation after replay: if sum(billable_units where entitlement_verified=true) < ledger_total then issue credits per partner-contract rules. threshold: > $50 or > 0.5%.

Dana (partner-success): I'll draft partner/customer notes: apology, mitigation, credit flow, timeline. Sam please review before send.

Sam (partnerships): Also proposing cutover-guard: for future marketplace flips default ingestion to non-invoiceable for 5m, auto-tag events, and reconcile after activations settle. Rohit/Kai can scope the low-risk change?

Rohit (sre): doable. I'll open a PR to add a cutover flag and safe-default. Kai will wire the tag propagation.

cutover-bot: NOTE: activation-worker autoscale fix applied at 2026-03-23T02:12:15Z. replay_job.completed=true; replayed_events=932; queue_depth=0.
